source: his 2026-11-10 09:2x "yeah" to OT-9I (space destroy) after the five 19 November parts played: the plan's first step, his classic MB14a's destroy ported onto the space board
_note: SPACE DESTROY PROBE SD1 (plan OT-9I): one shot-not-pressed object in orbit, silent, placeholder words. Not a mission.
Reading it: fly to the asteroid; there is no prompt on it. Shoot it with the ship's weapons: it goes, and the mission completes and pays easy. Papyrus.0.log should hold no error of ours.
Its health is his MB14a Dangerous Asteroid's (duo_MB14a_act), so if it takes too many or too few shots the fault is that number, not the beat. Unbuilt once a real space destroy has played.
